decisions.reason: After four years the two-component injection unit still fits a niche the firm knows well and costs little to keep listed and supply with parts, so the option stays open even though 2020-2021 results are not observed.
Its overlap with A makes consolidation more likely as results come in, but nothing so far shows its value is lost, and keeping it is cheap, so it stays for now.
The automatic airless gun shares components with the core range and supports pump sales, so holding it costs very little and the option is worth keeping.
A manual airless gun is a staple of the spray business with steady demand and minimal holding cost, so there is no reason to abandon it.
The multi-model air-assisted line can be trimmed variant by variant rather than dropped, so the line as a whole stays while weaker models are pruned.
